That first hug, that first kiss, that moment when all the miles between you finally disappear. For a little while, the distance doesn’t exist anymore. 🥹❤️ But then comes the part nobody can ever prepare you for… having to say goodbye all over again. Walking away from the person who feels like home, knowing you’re leaving a piece of your heart behind.
